name: Fort Frederick State Park
winter_2026_27: Self-contained units only, first come first served, every night 2026-11-16 to 2027-02-28. The calendar shows every Family Camping Area site as walk-up the whole time.
winter_loops: Family Camping Area, sites 001-027 (27 sites; the RA type is tent, but self-contained units may use them). The Youth Group Area (4 sites) also shows walk-up.
winter_limits: Self-contained units only; tent camping only from the first Saturday in May to the first Sunday in November. FCFS: advance reservations are taken only for 2027-05-07 to 2027-10-31. No potable water in the campground; water and a dumpster are 3/5 mile away near the railroad tracks. Portable toilets only in the May-November season. A flush comfort station is near the fort parking lot, but its winter status is not stated. Park hours November-March are 10 a.m. to sunset. No dump station is mentioned.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: self-contained units may camp year round, first come first served off-season (no potable water in the campground, portable toilets only May-early November); tent camping first Saturday in May to first Sunday in November; campground closed during April's Market Fair.

sources.quote: Self-contained camping units may camp year round. (The campground is closed during Market Fair in April...) / There is no potable water in the campground. Potable water and a dumpster for campsite guests are located near the railroad tracks, 3/5 of a mile from the campground. / Portable toilets are located in the campground the first Saturday in May to the first Sunday in November.

Status: Open through Sun Oct 31 2027 / 2027 Reservable Dates All Campsites: May 7, 2027-October 31, 2027 / Advanced reservations are taken during the season dates listed above. Self-contained camping units may camp year round. ... 29 campsites year round. / November through March: 10 a.m. to sunset

name: Assateague Island National Seashore (Maryland district campgrounds)
winter_2026_27: Open every night 2026-11-16 to 2027-02-28. Oceanside Loop 2 is first come first served from Nov 16 to Mar 14. Bayside is FCFS on the calendar Nov 16 to Feb 28 (a few nights already show Reserved), then reservable from Mar 1. The 2 equestrian sites can be booked all winter.
winter_loops: Oceanside Loop 2, sites 020-041 (FCFS). Bayside Loop A A01-A24, Loop B B25-B37 (no B34), Loop C C38-C49. Equestrian Horse Camp A and B. Closed Nov 16 to Mar 14: Oceanside Loop 1 (001-019), every walk-in site (042-104) and group sites G1-G5.
winter_limits: Showers (unheated) run Mar 15 to Nov 15 only. Campground water is available only when temperatures are above freezing; the dump stations have water year round. Oceanside is FCFS Nov 16 to Mar 14.
season_note: Winter 2026-27: open year-round; Bayside drive-in sites and Oceanside Loop 2 (first come first served Nov 16-Mar 14) stay open, Oceanside Loop 1, walk-in and group sites close Nov 16-Mar 14; showers Mar 15-Nov 15 only, campground water only above freezing, dump-station water year round.

sources.quote: (campground record via /api/camps/campgrounds/232507, updated 2026-02-04) The campground is open year-round... Bayside Individual sites: Year-round... Oceanside Individual sites: From March 15 through November 15 each year (first come first serve only, November 16 - March 14)... unheated showers (March 15 - November 15 only)... Water in the campground is available when temperatures are above freezing, and year round at the dump stations.

Months 2026-11 to 2027-03: Oceanside Loop 1 'Closed' 11-16 to 03-14; Oceanside Loop 2 'Not Reservable' 11-16 to 03-14, then 'Available'; Walk-in and Group 'Closed'; Bayside A/B/C 'Not Reservable' 11-16 to 02-28 with a few 'Reserved', 'Available' from 03-01; Equestrian 'Available' all winter.

(last updated December 6, 2024) Loop 1 sites are closed from November 16 -through March 14. Loop 2 sites are available on a First Come, First Served basis from November 16 through March 14 / Bayside Drive-in ... can be reserved year round
(last updated Oct 30, 2026) Oceanside and Bayside campgrounds are open.

weak_spots: Sources disagree on Bayside. NPS (stale, 2024) says it 'can be reserved year round', but the rec.gov calendar shows it Not Reservable (FCFS, presumed) Nov 16 to Feb 28, apart from a few Reserved nights. 'Not Reservable' could also mean closed, but the rec.gov description says Bayside is open year-round. Equestrian sites are horse-camp only.

name: Rocky Gap State Park
winter_2026_27: Sources conflict. DNR says the campground closed for renovation on 2026-10-13, and the RA alert says it is closed October 2026 to January 2029. Yet the RA season block and the live calendar still offer Ash Loop for 2026-11-16 to 11-25 and 2026-11-30 to 12-13 (some nights already Reserved). Every other loop is closed, and all loops are closed from 2026-12-14.
winter_loops: Per the RA calendar only: Ash Loop electric sites 001-003, 005-009, 011-019, 022-025 and 027-030, through 2026-12-13. The other loops (Birch to Ironwood) are closed.
winter_limits: Unknown; renovation work is under way (pads, amenities, utilities).
season_note: Winter 2026-27: campground closed for renovation from October 13, 2026 (DNR says through December 31, 2027; the reservation alert says until the 2029 season), though the reservation calendar still lists Ash Loop nights through December 13, 2026; normal season Ash and Elm loops mid-March to mid-October, other loops May 1 to mid-October.

status.note: Closed for renovation from 2026-10-13; DNR says through 2027-12-31, the RA alert says back for the 2029 camping season.
